adjudication.rationale: In the newly added app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, `comments` is assigned `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and is used immediately via `comments.appendChild(iframe);` with no guard. If the host page does not include an element with id `discourse-comments`, `comments` will be `null` and this will throw a runtime TypeError, breaking the embed script.
